questions.question: If 20 March 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 23 April 2021?
questions.questionHtml: If 20 March 2001 is Tuesday, then what will be the day of the week on 23 April 2021?
questions.solution:
If 20 March 2001 is Tuesday,

Then, 20 March 2021 will be = Tuesday + (1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1) = Tuesday + 25 = Saturday

Number of days between 20 March 2021 to 23 April 2021 = (11 + 23) = 34

34 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

Saturday + 6 = Friday

Therefore, it will be Friday on 23 April 2021.

Hence, ‘Friday’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 25 October 2004 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 2 November 2007?
questions.questionHtml: If 25 October 2004 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 2 November 2007?
questions.solution:
Given: 25 October 2004 was Monday.

Now,

2004 to 2007 = 3 Years (3 Ordinary Years).

And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days.

then, 25 October 2007 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 25 October 2007 to 2 November 2007

= 6 days (October) + 2 days (November) = 8 days.

= 8 days → 8/7 = 1 week and 1 odd days.

So, 2 November 2007 will be Thursday + 1 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 26 January 2019 was Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2022?

questions.solution:
⇒ There are 366 weeks and 2 days from 26 January 2019 to 30 January 2022.
⇒ 2 days divided by 7 days in a week has a remainder of 2.
⇒ 30 January 2022 is Sunday.

questions.question: If 15 January 2019 was a Tuesday, then what day of the week was it on 29 January 2020?
questions.questionHtml: If 15 January 2019 was a Tuesday, then what day of the week was it on 29 January 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: 15 January 2019 was Tuesday.

Now,

2019 to 2020 = 1 Year (1 Ordinary Year).

And, In 1 Year = 1 Ordinary Year.

then, 15 January 2020 will be Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday.

Now, the number of days between 15 January 2020 to 29 January 2020

= 14 days.

= 14 days → 14/7 = 2 weeks and 0 odd day.

So, 29 January 2020 will be Wednesday .

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question: If 17 August 2003 was a Sunday, then what was the day of the week on 12 September 2014?
questions.questionHtml: If 17 August 2003 was a Sunday, then what was the day of the week on 12 September 2014?
questions.solution:
Start from 17 August 2003 (Sunday). Over 11 years, there are 14 odd

days (8 ordinary years + 3 leap years). Thus, 17 August 2014 is also

Sunday. From 17 August to 12 September 2014 is 26 days, which is 3

weeks and 5 odd days. Therefore, 12 September 2014 is a Friday.

questions.question: If it was Tuesday on 21 February 2017, then what will be the day of the week on 5 February 2025 ? (2020 and 2024 are leap years.)
questions.questionHtml: If it was Tuesday on 21 February 2017, then what will be the day of the week on 5 February 2025 ? (2020 and 2024 are leap years.)
questions.solution:
The number of odd days from 21 February 2017 to 5 February 2025 :

Year Period Calculation Odd days
2017 21 February 2017 - 31 December 2017 365 days - 52 days = 313 days 313 ÷ 7 = 5
2018 - 2024 Full year (5 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years) (1 × 5) + (2 × 2) = 9 9 ÷ 7 = 2
2025 1st January 2025 - 5th February 2025 31 day + 5 days = 36 days 36 ÷ 7 = 1
Total odd days (8 ÷ 7) = 1

∴ The number of odd days from 21 February 2017 to 5 February 2025 ⇒ 1

⇒So, One odd day get added to Tuesday because day asked in future.

∴ Wednesday was the day of the week on the 5 February 2025.

questions.question: If 29 November 2009 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 30 May 2010?
questions.questionHtml: If 29 November 2009 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 30 May 2010?
questions.solution:
Number of odd days between 29 November 2009 to 30 May 2010 = (1 + 3 + 3 + 0 + 3 + 2 + 30) = 42

42 when divided by 7, leaves 0 as remainder.

Sunday + 0 = Sunday

Hence, ‘Sunday’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 15th January 1996 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 30th March 1997?
questions.questionHtml: If 15th January 1996 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 30th March 1997?
questions.solution:
The number of odd days from 15th January 1996 to 30th March 1997 :

Years Period Calculations Odd days
1996 (Leap year) 15th January 1996 - 31 December 1996 366 days - 15 days = 351 days 351 ÷ 7 = 1
1997 (ordinary year) 1st January 1997 - 30th March 1997 31 days + 28 days + 30 days = 89 days 89 ÷ 7 = 5
Total odd days 6

∴ The number of odd days from 15th January 1996 to 30th March 1997 ⇒ 6

⇒So, Six odd day get added to Monday because day asked in future.

∴ Sunday was the day of the week on the 30th March 1997.

questions.question: If 1 January 2020 was a Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 1 January 2021?

questions.solution:
Logic: A normal year advances the day of the year by 1 day. And a leap year advances the day of the year by 2 days. 

1 January 2021 → Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

questions.question: If 23 June 2008 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 23 June 2020?
questions.questionHtml: If 23 June 2008 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 23 June 2020?
questions.solution:

Now,

2008 to 2020 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap Years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

15 odd days → 15/7 = 2 weeks and 1 odd day.

then, 23 June 2020 will be Monday + 1 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If exactly 1 year and 2 days later it is Tuesday, then what day is it today? It is not a leap year.
questions.questionHtml: If exactly 1 year and 2 days later it is Tuesday, then what day is it today? It is not a leap year.
questions.solution:

Normal year = 365 days = 52 weeks + 1 day

As per the question:

1 year and 2 days later is Tuesday, which means the last day of the year is Saturday.

In a normal year first and last days are the same means today is also Saturday.

questions.question: In a month of 29 days, the second Thursday falls on the 13th day of the month. What day of the week will be the second last day of the month?
questions.questionHtml: In a month of 29 days, the second Thursday falls on the 13th day of the month. What day of the week will be the second last day of the month?
questions.solution:
Given: 13th February of the month = Thursday. (As, 29 days month is February)

So, second last day of the month means 28th February,

And, days between 13th February to 28th February - 15 days.

And, 15 days = 15/7 = 2 week and 1 odd day.

Then, the second last day of the month will be: Thursday + 1 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 5 Ordinary Years have 5 odd days.

then, 19 November 2010 will be Wednesday + 2 = Friday.

Now, the number of days between 19 November 2010 to 25 March 2011

= 11 (remaining days in November) + 31 (December) + 31 (January) + 28 (February) + 25 (March) = 126 days.

= 126 days → 126/7 = 18 weeks and 0 odd days.

So, 25 March 2011 will be Friday + 0 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

55 when divided by 7, leaves 6 as remainder.

questions.question: If 21 July 2000 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2012?
questions.questionHtml: If 21 July 2000 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 July 2012?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 21 July 2000 is Friday.

Then, 21 July 2012 will be = Friday + (1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2) = Friday + 15 = Saturday

Number of odd days between 15 July 2012 to 21 July 2012 = 6

Saturday - 6 = Sunday

So, it will be Sunday on 15 July 2012.

Hence, ‘Sunday’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.questionHtml: If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.solution:
From, 1 January 2009 to 31 January 2013 = 4 Years.

And, 4 years has 1 leap and 3 ordinary year

So total odd days = (1 × 2) + (3 × 1) = 2 + 3 = 5 odd days.

So, 31 January 2013 = Saturday + 5 = Thursday.

But, we need to find the day on 30 January 2013, so subtract 1 day from 31 January 2013.

Therefore, 30 January 2013 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

questions.question: If 17 December 2012 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 18 November 2020?
questions.questionHtml: If 17 December 2012 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 18 November 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: 17 December 2012 was Monday.

Now,

2012 to 2020 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap Years and 6 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Years have 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 17 December 2020 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 18 November 2020 to 17 December 2020

= 12 + 17 = 29 days.

= 29 days → 29/7 = 4 weeks and 1 odd days.

The dates are in past, so subtract 1 days from the day on 17 December 2020 which is Thursday

So, 18 November 2020 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: If 29 July 2001 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 20 February 2015?

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 11 Ordinary Years have 11 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 11 = 17.

18 odd days → 17/7 = 2 weeks and 3 odd days.

then, 29 July 2015 will be Sunday + 3 = Wednesday.

Now, the number of days between 20 February 2015 to 29 July 2015.

= 8 (Feb) + 31 (March) + 30 (Apr) + 31 (May) + 30 (June) + 29 (July) = 159 days.

= 159 days → 159/7 = 22 weeks and 5 odd day.

So, 20 February 2015 will be Wednesday - 5 = Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Therefore, 19 September 1983 = Saturday + 2 = Monday.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

then, 22 March 2009 will be Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

= 300 days → 300/7 = 42 weeks and 6 odd days.

questions.question: If 11 October 1969 is Saturday, then what day of the week will it be on 29 November 1977?
questions.questionHtml: If 11 October 1969 is Saturday, then what day of the week will it be on 29 November 1977?
questions.solution:
Given:

11 October 1969 = Saturday

29 November 1977 = ?

As we know:

Odd days in a normal year = 1

questions.question: If 29 December 1956 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 16 January 1967?
questions.questionHtml: If 29 December 1956 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 16 January 1967?
questions.solution:
Given: 29 December 1956 was Saturday.

Now,

1956 to 1966 = 10 Years (8 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 10 Years = 2 Leap years and 8 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 8 Ordinary Years have 8 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 8 = 12.

12 odd days → 12/7 = 1 week and 5 odd days.

then, 29 December 1966 will be Saturday + 5 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 29 December 1966 to 16 January 1967

= 2(December) + 16(January) = 18 days.

= 18 days → 18/7 = 2 weeks and 4 odd days.

So, 16 January 1967 will be Thursday + 4 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 3 April 1996 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 April 2001?
questions.questionHtml: If 3 April 1996 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 7 April 2001?
questions.solution:
start from 3 April 1996 (Wednesday) and calculate the total odd days from

1996 to 2001 (6 odd days).

This makes 3 April 2001 a Tuesday. Adding 4 days to this, 7 April 2001 is

a Saturday.

questions.question: If 20 February 2013 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 28 February 2016?
questions.questionHtml: If 20 February 2013 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 28 February 2016?
questions.solution:
⇒ The number of odd days from 20 February 2013 to 28 February 2016 is 2 (2 ordinary years).
⇒ 2 odd days = Thursday.
⇒ 28 February 2016 is a Sunday.
